display_name: Select the cheapest (model, effort) that clears a capability score
description: Select the cheapest enabled accepted scored/priced catalog cell clearing required_score plus margin, within runtime when supplied. Operator enablement is applied once before pins, constraints, frontier, domination and ladders. Disabled cells remain visible in catalog and read_model_cell_policy, but cannot be selected or pinned. set_model_cells_enabled supports AND selectors (provider, runtime, model_family_prefix, exact model, effort), atomic only selection, correction and clear with optimistic policy updated_at premises. Refresh/reseed/manual recording preserve choices; standing rules govern future cells. Existing receipt replay reuses the enabled filter with no receipt redesign. Allowance telemetry is independent: exhausted, unknown, missing, expired or unreadable readings never participate in selection or cost ranking, and quota admission/advisory/expired-reading fields are absent. Economics still supplies prices and declared allowance_weighted dispatch weights for a covered runtime. Explicit metered unconstrained selection does not load the quota profile. A constrained malformed economics profile refuses usage_economics_invalid because its weights cannot be read. Stale catalog readings remain usable and appear in stale_readings and warnings; a stale selection queues a refresh when no recent refresh exists. Optional constraints exclude runtimes/model prefixes/efforts before feasibility. An enabled accepted scored pin with nonempty pin_basis may override per-call constraints, threshold and capability floor, with advisories; runtime must match. Receipts retain existing optional-default canonicalization, immutable replay and tuple checks.
embedding_description: Choosing which AI model and reasoning-effort setting to assign a piece of work so that it is capable enough for the job at the lowest cost, with the reasoning shown and a stale-data notice, never a refusal, when the price and score data are old.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Selected tuple, objective, required/effective score, frontier, dominated cells, effort ladder, excluded counts including operator_disabled, stale advisories/readings, catalog run, policy version, unscored count and existing selection_receipt. cost_basis exposes economics weights when relevant; warnings expose stale catalog, truncated census or missing weights. No quota admission or expired allowance reading output.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Name the selected model and effort with its score and cost, then the next cheapest frontier alternative. If the ladder shows a near-zero points_per_cost_unit step, say that raising effort on this model buys little. Do not restate every excluded count unless asked. If warnings is present, tell the operator its text in plain words; a stale-reading notice is never a reason to stop or to pick by hand.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Pass selected.runtime, selected.model, selected.effort, required_score as difficulty_score, and selection_receipt unchanged to spawn_session or dispatch_managed_work. A no_cell_clears_threshold refusal means the ask exceeds available capability; do not pick by hand. When stale_readings is not empty the selection is still valid: dispatch with it, and report the oldest age to the operator. The call has already queued a refresh when the notice says so; do not call refresh_model_capability_catalog yourself on every stale selection, and if readings are still stale after a day, tell the operator that refreshing is not working and file an issue. To spawn on a specific runtime, pass runtime to this verb and use the resulting receipt; a receipt issued without it is only valid for the runtime it selected unconstrained.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One catalog read plus an in-memory selection; the dispatch policy JSON is loaded when dispatch_kind is given. No writes, no network; a stale selection returns a refresh request that the plugin submits as a follow-on action.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: catalog_empty: no enabled scored cells; read_model_cell_policy to inspect operator decisions. catalog_unaccepted: no enabled cell accepted. catalog_unknown_effort: enabled scored cells have no known effort. no_cell_clears_threshold: no enabled accepted priced cell clears the requested score under constraints/floors. pin_cell_unavailable: requested cell is absent, disabled, unaccepted or unscored. parameter_invalid: malformed request. usage_economics_invalid: constrained economics weights are malformed/unreadable/ambiguous. State and receipt integrity errors propagate. Allowance telemetry cannot refuse selection.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Inspect catalog and read_model_cell_policy. The current Operator may correct/retire rules or clear policy using the latest updated_at premise; disabling is deliberate and never bypassed with a pin. Clear/correct per-call constraints or lower a capability ask as appropriate. Stale catalog data is advisory; report a failed refresh without blocking dispatch.
